PROFILE
Nursing Supervisor with 7 years of experience in clinical nursing.
They led day-care unit operations, and their recent work centred on outpatient department flow.

WORK HISTORY
Nursing Supervisor, Kalyani Health Trust (2022 - Present)
- Owned emergency admissions workflow for 800 patients, drawing on Patient Education to improve ward readiness by 19%.
- Applied Vital Signs Monitoring across day-care unit operations, improving medication error rate by 9%.
- Delivered post-operative ward coordination for 2500 patients, drawing on Ventilator Management to improve ward readiness by 12%.
- Applied Triage across medical-surgical unit handover, improving ward readiness by 44%.
- Owned outpatient department flow for 350 patients, drawing on Medication Administration to improve ward readiness by 15%.

Senior Staff Nurse, Shanti Multispeciality Hospital (2019 - 2022)
- Applied IV Therapy across emergency admissions workflow, improving discharge turnaround by 11%.
- Built maternity ward rounds for 120 patients, drawing on Medication Administration to improve patient satisfaction by 40%.

CORE COMPETENCIES
Core: Electronic Health Records, Vital Signs Monitoring, Patient Assessment, Medication Administration, IV Therapy, Infection Control, Basic Life Support, Patient Education, Wound Care
Additional: Ventilator Management, Triage

ACADEMIC BACKGROUND
B.Sc. Nursing, Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, 2019


PERSONAL DETAILS
Affiliations: Member, Student Nurses Association (2 years)
Spoken languages: English (fluent)
Community: Volunteer, local community food drive
Interests: Long-distance running, chess
